interface Loopback126
   ip address 192.0.2.126/24
   ip ospf cost 126
router ospf 126
   passive-interface Loopback126
   network 192.0.2.0/24 area 198.51.100.126
   max-lsa 12000
ip prefix-list NETOPS-G126-P seq 10 permit 192.0.2.0/24
route-map NETOPS-G126-M permit 10
   match ip address prefix-list NETOPS-G126-P
route-map NETOPS-G126-M permit 10
   match ip address prefix-list NETOPS-G126-P
